title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: AI skill to investigate policy sync and device health
summary: Hold: the briefing treats Microsoft 365 E5 and E7 coverage as unknown even though Microsoft's inclusion rule covers all Purview agentic scenarios. It also reports no automation for the Purview plugin despite a documented beta PowerShell plugin-enablement operation. The roadmap dates, supplied tenant notice and manual troubleshooting paths are supported.
